req.title: Register form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a registration form at GET /auth/register.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to verify the functionality of the registration form endpoint, ensuring it serves the correct form on a GET request, handles errors appropriately, and respects boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_register_form_get_positive
preconditions: The application is running with the test configuration.
expected: The response contains the registration form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/auth/register')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in response.data
assert b'name="username"' in response.data
assert b'name="password"' in response.data

tests.name: test_register_form_get_boundary
preconditions: The application is running with the test configuration.
actions: Send a GET request to /auth/register with a large query string.
expected: The response contains the registration form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
query_string = '?' + 'a' * 2048
response = client.get('/auth/register' + query_string)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in response.data
assert b'name="username"' in response.data
assert b'name="password"' in response.data
